predecessors.name: Shunga Empire
predecessors.text: the Shunga realm handed to Vasudeva Kanva: Pataliputra, Vidisha and the Ganges plain (the page gives no boundary)

successors.name: Satavahana dynasty
successors.text: Central India around Vidisha, where 'The defeat of the Kanva dynasty by the Satavahana dynasty was a localised event'

ledger.x: 73 BCE: Vasudeva Kanva takes the throne at Pataliputra.
28 BCE: the Satavahanas end the Kanva dynasty.

wars.name: Satavahana overthrow of the Kanvas
wars.outcome: The Satavahanas ended the Kanva dynasty in 28 BCE; 'a localised event in Central India'.

certainty.note: No frontier is dated or surveyed; the page gives capitals and coin findspots only.
